verdict.rationale: ROCm documentation explicitly lists RX 9000 series (including 9070 XT) as a supported target on both Windows and Linux, with PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, and Llama.cpp support, plus a stated migration path to AMD Instinct datacenter GPUs. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of ROCm workflows on this specific card beyond vendor docs, and no mention of CUDA compatibility layer maturity/limitations.
